insight: Raised a $55M Series C led by Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives in 2025, bringing total funding to $100M.
name: Navina
tagline: AI copilot that turns scattered patient data into point-of-care insights.
description: Navina is a clinician-first AI platform for primary care and value-based care that consolidates fragmented patient records into a clear summary and surfaces actionable insights at the point of care — care gaps, HCC risk-adjustment coding, and ambient documentation. It integrates with electronic health records including Epic, athenahealth, and Veradigm, and is sold to provider groups, ACOs, MSOs, and health plans.
edge: Tuned for value-based care: surfaces HCC risk-adjustment coding and care-gap closure alongside the visit summary, not just ambient notes.
pros: Surfaces care gaps and HCC coding at visit
Synthesizes fragmented records into a summary
